hook: Traffic police book *5 cases* over fake, tampered number plates
hook_b: Traffic police book *5 cases* over fake, tampered number plates
tldr: A week-long special drive from November 5 to 12 led to five cases and several vehicle seizures, Telangana Today reports.

beats.what: Cases were registered at Toli Chowk, Bahadurpura, Banjara Hills, Chilakalguda and Atmakur in Wanaparthy district.
beats.why: Fake plates hide a vehicle's identity and help riders evade traffic e-challans and enforcement, police said.
beats.care: Joint CP (Traffic) D Joel Davis said fake or altered plates mean a criminal case and seizure; only government-approved HSRP plates are allowed, no altered digits or unauthorised stickers.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Drive ran Nov 5-12; several vehicles seized.

cards.q: Is a criminal case the right response to fake plates?

qs: How do traffic cameras catch a tampered plate?
Where in the city are fake plates most common? Police did not say.

facts.t: Cases came from *Toli Chowk, Bahadurpura, Banjara Hills, Chilakalguda* and Atmakur.

viz.verdict: Enforcement drive; rule is HSRP only

learn.t: HSRP = High Security Registration Plate, the tamper-proof plate approved by the government.

watch: Whether the drive continues and more seizures follow.

twist: Police found *multiple registration numbers* used on the same two-wheelers to dodge enforcement.
